record.explanation: GPS is a satellite-based navigation system, with space, control and user segments. “Satellite system” is the appropriate offered class; a station or individual signal is not the whole GPS. Reference: https://www.gps.gov/gps. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
